notizie.titolo: PG&E Launches Strategic Review. Wildfire Liability Has the Utility Seriously Worried.
notizie.riassunto: PG&E  on Wednesday was still sufficiently worried about wildfire-related liability that it announced a broad strategic review, even as California lawmakers shelved legislation that could have left utilities open to widespread legal claims.  The utility said it will conduct a review to identify affordable, long-term capital and that it plans to “consider the full range of options” for how  PG&E  is organized and financed.  Along with the review, PG&E reduced its 2027 capital investment plan by $2 billion to $11.4 billion, from $13.4 billion.
